howToChange: Owner WS0. Ordinals (`id`) are append-only forever: never reorder, renumber or delete an entry. A new builtin, alias or unsupported entry is appended as T1 (minor version bump; `node tools/gen-builtins.ts` and `node tools/gen-dsdb.ts` regenerate their outputs in the same commit; CHANGELOG entry). WS7 fills `doc`/`example` fields left as TODO(WS7) as T0 changes on its own branch. Changing the id, name, kind or signature of a function, variable or constant entry changes the ABI hash (contracts/dsdb.md) and is T2.

entries.name: instance_create
entries.doc: Makes a new instance of an object at (x, y) on the object's screen, runs its Create event and gives back its id.

entries.name: instance_destroy
entries.doc: Removes an instance (this one when you give no id) at the end of the event. Its Destroy event runs first.

entries.name: button_check
entries.doc: true while the button is held down.

entries.name: button_pressed
entries.doc: true only in the frame the button goes down.

entries.name: touch_pressed
entries.doc: true only in the frame the stylus touches the bottom screen, anywhere on it. Works in objects on either screen.

entries.name: draw_text
entries.doc: Writes a value as text with the 8x8 DS font. x and y snap to 8-pixel cells. Numbers print like string() does.

entries.name: room_restart
entries.doc: Starts the current room again at the end of this frame. Room End runs; global variables stay.

entries.name: audio_play_sound
entries.doc: Plays a sound effect once. If all 16 channels are busy the sound is skipped.

entries.name: floor
entries.doc: Rounds down to a whole number.

entries.name: round
entries.doc: Rounds to the nearest whole number; halves round away from zero.

entries.name: abs
entries.doc: The value without its minus sign.

entries.name: clamp
entries.doc: Keeps a value between lo and hi.

entries.name: irandom_range
entries.doc: A random whole number from lo to hi, both included.

entries.name: string
entries.doc: Turns a value into text. Fractions print with at most 2 decimals (0.125 prints 0.13).

entries.name: show_debug_message
entries.doc: Prints a value in the Output panel (a DSD|LOG line). Any value works; numbers print like string() does.

entries.name: x
entries.doc: The instance's horizontal position in the room, in pixels.

entries.name: y
entries.doc: The instance's vertical position in the room, in pixels (down is bigger).

entries.name: hspeed
entries.doc: Horizontal speed in pixels per frame; the engine adds it to x every step.

entries.name: vspeed
entries.doc: Vertical speed in pixels per frame; the engine adds it to y every step.

entries.name: gravity
entries.doc: Added to the speed every step, in the gravity_direction (270 = down).

entries.name: sprite_height
entries.doc: The sprite's height in pixels, times image_yscale.

entries.name: image_speed
entries.doc: How many animation frames to advance per step (0.2 = one frame every 5 steps).

entries.name: image_yscale
entries.doc: Vertical stretch; DS sprites can grow to at most 2x.

entries.name: alarm
entries.doc: Eight countdown timers. Set alarm[n] to a number of steps; when it reaches 0 the alarm_n event runs.

entries.name: room_width
entries.doc: The current room's width in pixels.

entries.name: room_height
entries.doc: The current room's height in pixels.

entries.name: other
entries.doc: In a collision event, the instance you hit; inside with(), the instance that ran the with.
